title: sylva 0.1.0 published, and the repository public
body: Published to crates.io on 2026-10-20 (tag v0.1.0), and github.com/vaibhav-gopal/sylva made public with it. The crate holds 37 files (Cargo.toml include: the code, benchmarks, license texts, README, DESIGN, CONTACT, SECURITY); docs.rs builds with all features. crates.io accepted license = "GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Royalty-Free-1.0 OR LicenseRef-Commercial-1.0" (the WITH clause untried; told vg-paradigms). The first attempt was refused only for an unverified crates.io email.
